lines.zh: 浑水里的芦苇根，我贴着游
lines.en: I hug the reed roots in this murky water.

lines.zh: 这段沼泽水道我熟得像窝
lines.en: I know this swamp channel as well as my nest.

lines.zh: 水浅了，我的背快露出水面
lines.en: The water is shallow, my back nearly breaks the surface.

lines.zh: 莲叶下面凉快，我往那边挪
lines.en: It is cooler under the lily pads, I drift that way.
One flick of my tail stirs up the mud.

lines.zh: 这条沟连着大沼泽，错不了
lines.en: This ditch runs to the great swamp, I am sure.
There is a net ahead, I will go around it.
Weeds caught my fin, two shakes and I am free.
I swim along the shadow of the fallen log.

lines.zh: 青蛙在岸上跳，水里有动静
lines.en: Frogs hop on the bank, something moves in the water.
Deeper now, where the water runs colder.
The mud bottom is slick, I ride the current.

lines.zh: 桶的影子又靠近了，快躲
lines.en: A bucket shadow nears again, time to hide.

lines.zh: 我游过整片睡莲去对岸
lines.en: I cross the whole lily field to the far bank.
I back into the weeds.

lines.zh: 泥里冒出一串泡，我嗅了嗅。
lines.en: A string of bubbles rises from the mud. I sniff at it.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水今天有点发绿
lines.en: The swamp water has turned a little green today.
I open my mouth and duckweed drifts in.
A swarm of mosquitoes has settled on my back.
I count the bubbles rising to the surface.
There are grubs in the mud, I root for them.

lines.zh: 岸上那头牛在喝水，真吵
lines.en: That cow on the bank drinks loudly, so noisy.
My scales look especially bright today.

lines.zh: 水退了一点，石头露出来
lines.en: The water dropped, and the stones show through.
I doze beneath a lily pad, out of sight.

lines.zh: 有人往水里丢了面包屑
lines.en: Someone tossed bread crumbs into the water.
I am the only one in this pond.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有桶碰石头
lines.en: I hear a bucket knock against stone far off.

lines.zh: 水底的枯叶积了厚厚一层
lines.en: Dead leaves lie thick on the bottom.
I bit the algae, and it tastes bitter.
You carry a bucket, and I know what it means.
Your shadow lies heavy on the water.
Do not step into the mud, it spooks me.
You crushed the reeds along the bank.
I rise to the surface to see who it is.
You smell of fishing bait.
Stand farther back, you are clouding the water.
Are you waiting for me to leap out?

lines.zh: 我不认识你，但我盯着你
lines.en: I do not know you, but my eyes stay on you.
Your reflection looks taller than you.
Who is poking me underwater?
My side fin just got cut.
There is no cover in this mud.
That blow left me dizzy.
My scales came off in the silt.
The water has turned a little red.
I am burrowing hard into the roots.
It hurts, I thrash and dart away.
Not another hit, I cannot take it.
I sink to the bottom and play dead.

lines.zh: 那团蚯蚓落水了，我过去
lines.en: That ball of worms hit the water, I am coming.
Bread crumbs drift my way, just in time.
The bait in your palm wriggles, and smells rich.

lines.zh: 我只吃落在水面的东西
lines.en: I only eat what lands on the surface.

lines.zh: 那根线太粗，我有点疑心
lines.en: That line looks thick, and I am suspicious.
Toss it closer, I cannot reach it.
The bug is sinking, and I chase it.
This worm is fatter than yesterday's.

lines.zh: 我咬住又松开，再试一口
lines.en: I bite and let go, then try once more.

lines.zh: 饵后面藏着钩，我看见了
lines.en: There is a hook behind the bait, I can see it.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，别撞我的侧鳍
lines.en: You stepped in, do not bump my side fin.
The net touched me, back away now.
Your wake keeps shaking the water.
I just bumped into your boot.
Do not tap my back with the bucket rim.
You stepped into the hollow where I hide.
Move back, you are kicking up silt.
You knocked a scale loose from my side.
Now the whole pond has gone cloudy.
You are blocking my burrow, I cannot get out.
The spring water warms, time to find a mate.
I circle through the reed bed.
That bass is a size smaller than me.
I slap the water a little louder.

lines.zh: 她躲在莲叶后面，我看见了
lines.en: She hides behind a lily pad, but I saw her.
We swim side by side across the shallows.

lines.zh: 卵要藏在草根下面才安全
lines.en: The eggs are safest under the reed roots.
This ditch is my territory.
Another male is swimming much too close.
I circle her with my tail fin spread wide.

lines.zh: 那颗果子沉下来，我碰一下
lines.en: A berry sank down, I nudge it once.
I do not eat things that glitter.
A pebble fell in the mud, I push it aside.

lines.zh: 这块面包泡软了，我试试
lines.en: This bread is soggy, I will try it.

lines.zh: 我把蚯蚓叼到石头缝里
lines.en: I carry the worm into a crack between stones.
Someone dropped iron scrap, far too hard.
I butted against the sunken log.

lines.zh: 水面上的叶子我吃不下
lines.en: I cannot eat the leaf floating up there.
I hold it in my mouth, then spit it out.

lines.zh: 这个亮片晃眼，别丢下来
lines.en: This shiny chip is blinding, stop dropping it.
Something is thrashing in the water.

lines.zh: 那只青蛙落水了，我盯住
lines.en: A frog fell in, and I have my eyes on it.

lines.zh: 泥里那条虫在动，我来了
lines.en: A worm stirs in the mud, I am coming.
A shrimp darts by the stones, I follow.

lines.zh: 水面有虫子落下，好机会
lines.en: An insect dropped onto the surface, good chance.

lines.zh: 那条小鱼闯进我的水域
lines.en: That small fish swam into my water.

lines.zh: 我把嘴对准了水面的影子
lines.en: I aim my mouth at the shadow on the surface.
The tadpoles by the bank are crowded.
I beat my tail and speed up, spraying water.
It burrowed into the mud, so I wait.

lines.zh: 我绕到它后面，水流帮我
lines.en: I swing behind it, the current helps me.
When it stops, I close in half an inch.
Its shadow on the mud gives it away.
I hold my mouth open and wait.

lines.zh: 它往草里钻，我堵住出口
lines.en: It dives into the weeds, I block the way out.
The more the water churns, the more it panics.
I hug the bottom and make no sound.
It circled three times but stayed put.
I slowly tighten the circle around it.
It rises to breathe, now is the moment.
One bite, and the water bursts apart.
My mouth snapped shut in an instant.
It got sucked straight into my mouth.
The hit flipped it belly up.
I shake my head and pin it into the mud.
My teeth are blunt, but my grip is tight.
It struggled twice, then went limp.
I swallow it whole, my throat feels full.
A single bubble broke the surface, and it ended.
Do not put your hand in this water.

lines.zh: 我从沼泽的泥水里钻出来
lines.en: I rise out of the swamp mud.
This shallow water suits a spawning bed.
Once the rains come, there are more of us.

lines.zh: 芦苇根下藏着一窝小鱼
lines.en: A brood of small fry hides under the reeds.
I tested the water with a flick of my tail.

lines.zh: 泥岸塌了一块，我就来了
lines.en: A chunk of the bank collapsed, and here I am.
There is duckweed here for a whole season.
I let one bubble rise from the bottom.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水味我闻着就亲
lines.en: The swamp's smell feels like home to me.
I slip into the shadow of a lily pad.
The water scalds, I flee to the deep.
I hit the mud, scales buried in the dirt.
The water drained away, and my mouth gapes.
A blast underwater churned the mud up.
An arrow pierced the water but went wide.
A strange-tasting water washed over me.

lines.zh: 浮萍吃完了，我饿得发慌
lines.en: The duckweed is gone and hunger gnaws at me.
Lightning struck the surface, my head rings.
The water is gone, and emptiness waits below.
